verdict.rationale: EBANX's own docs include a chargeback section that claims merchants can "manage, respond to, and track chargeback cases", which maps to the core of the story. The evidence is a single one-line summary with no detail on how evidence is submitted or how the dispute lifecycle is represented. Missing for 10: documented structured evidence submission (fields, document uploads, API or dashboard flow), dispute lifecycle states and resolution outcomes, chargeback notifications or webhooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
